files.patch: @@ -851,6 +851,15 @@ const schema = { fastify.post('/url', { schema }, handler) ``` +> When the route declares a per-content-type response schema through `content`, +> Fastify matches the response `Content-Type` against the declared keys and falls +> back to `*/*` (if present). If the response `Content-Type` is not declared and +> there is no `*/*` key, serialization **fails closed**: Fastify throws +> `FST_ERR_MISSING_CONTENTTYPE_SERIALIZATION_FN` and replies with a `500` error, +> instead of silently serializing the payload with `JSON.stringify` (which would +> bypass the response schema). Every `Content-Type` a route may respond with must +> be declared, or the route must define a `*/*` catch-all. + #### Serializer Compiler
